messages:
ops-bot: Incident created: high 5xx/error spike on inference-service for model v7-experimental in us-west-2. Automated severity: P1. Paging oncall now.

maria (SRE): I see a sudden increase in model decode errors and 502s tied to v7-experimental. Error rate jumped from 0.2% -> 8% in last 5m. Latency also spiking for tail tokens.

jamie (oncall): I'm online, taking pager. Starting triage. Can someone post any recent deploys or config changes?

chen (Eng-Infra): No deploys from infra in last 30m. CI shows a model push to v7-experimental ~45m ago (automated onboarding). Might be a model-level regression.

maria (SRE): Agree. Traffic routing shows ~18% of production traffic hitting v7-experimental (canary split). Heavy keys concentrated from a small set of API keys — see quick query: `SELECT key, count(*) FROM requests WHERE variant='v7-experimental' GROUP BY key ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;`

jamie (oncall): We need immediate mitigation to stop user-facing errors. Options: 1) divert traffic off v7-experimental to a stable variant; 2) temporary throttle heavy keys; 3) enable circuit-breaker for v7-experimental. Preferences?

maria (SRE): Prioritize routing away from v7-experimental. While we shift, also apply per-key soft quota to limit blast radius. I'll coordinate both.

chen (Eng-Infra): I'll run the routing change. Command I'll run:
```
# move all traffic off experimental into v6-stable-backstop
redwoodctl routing update --from v7-experimental --to v6-stable-backstop --weight 100 --reason "emergency isolate v7-experimental"
```
I'll keep canary config but set weight=0 for v7-experimental.

ops-bot: Routing change initiated by chen (Eng-Infra). Change id rc_20260315_01.

maria (SRE): Simultaneously applying soft quotas for top 5 heavy keys to 1 rps to reduce error amplification:
```
# soft quota updates
redwoodctl quota set --key api_key_123 --qps 1 --burst 2 --reason "mitigate v7-experimental errors"
redwoodctl quota set --key enterprise_key_a --qps 1 --burst 2 --reason "mitigate v7-experimental errors"
```
This should throttle repeaters while we watch.

leah (Support): I'll draft messages for impacted customers and notify CS for the top 3 enterprise keys. Do we have estimated affected percent and expected degradation?

maria (SRE): Initial estimate: ~0.6% of active customers saw increased 5xx; top 3 keys account for ~42% of errors hitting v7. If routing succeeds, user-visible errors should drop to baseline in ~60s for dispatched requests.

ops-bot: Routing change rc_20260315_01 completed successfully. v7-experimental weight -> 0%. v6-stable-backstop weight -> +18%.

jamie (oncall): Traffic successfully diverted. Error rate for the service dropped back to ~0.3% within two minutes. Latency tail improving. Good first-order result.

maria (SRE): Next step: lock v7-experimental out of automatic rollout and mark it as quarantine. Also create a ticket for model owners to investigate decoding failure patterns (likely tokenization or new special tokens).

chen (Eng-Infra): Applied block to automated rollout pipeline for that model id: `ci/rollouts block --model v7-experimental --reason quarantine`

product-alerts-bot: Customer-impact summary needed for post-incident report. Please add: scope, mitigation, timeline, and customer outreach notes.

leah (Support): I'll send customer notifications now for the three enterprise keys with an acknowledgment and ETA for follow-up: "We've diverted traffic and throttled repeat callers; engineering is investigating. We'll share a follow-up within 2 hours."

maria (SRE): Also creating a temporary safe-rollout policy: any future model variant flagged as experimental must pass the new serving-smoke-test and be pinned behind a stricter canary gate (<=1% traffic) until manual approve. Filing RFC follow-up.

jamie (oncall): I'll stay on watch for 30 more minutes, monitoring dashboards: latency, 5xx, per-key errors, and routing. If we see new regressions, escalate to oncall-2.

chen (Eng-Infra): Opening a postmortem ticket now with required fields and assigning to model-owner team. Tagging logs and the model artifact: s3://model-artifacts/v7-experimental/commit-56af.

maria (SRE): Great. Summary for timeline (to be included in postmortem):
- t0 (1965432100) automated alert from ops-bot for spike
- t0+3m routing change to set v7-experimental weight=0 (rc_20260315_01)
- t0+4m soft quotas on heavy keys applied
- t0+6m errors dropped to baseline; customer outreach underway

leah (Support): Customer messages sent. CS acked receipt from two enterprise contacts and requested status updates.

jamie (oncall): Handing back to night shift. I'm logging final checks and will add monitoring annotations. If anything regresses, re-paging SRE. :wave:

maria (SRE): Thanks everyone. Closing live mitigation. Postmortem owners: model-team (root cause), eng-infra (routing review), devex (rollout gate).

ops-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation successful, severity downgraded to P2. Please update incident ticket and attach logs."
